name: What size guest house works best for short-term hosting?

mainEntity.name: What is the ideal size for a backyard guest house if it will mostly be used for weekend guests and visitors?
mainEntity.text: What is the ideal size for a backyard guest house if it will mostly be used for weekend guests and visitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: For mostly occasional use, the best guest house is usually smaller, simpler, and easier to maintain. Guests generally value comfort, privacy, and good light more than extra square footage. A studio or one-bedroom layout can work very well if it includes a comfortable bathroom, smart storage, and a layout that avoids wasted space. Larger units make sense when the homeowner also wants flexibility for longer stays, remote work, or multigenerational use. In practice, the right size is the smallest footprint that still feels generous and well-finished. That approach often creates a better experience and a more efficient budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: For short-term hosting, a compact layout often works best. A well-planned studio or one-bedroom guest house can feel more comfortable than a larger but poorly organized unit. The key is efficient circulation, a good bathroom, storage, and a private sleeping area.
